name: Invoice Hold
office_task: When a renovation job is marked complete, draft its one invoice in Xero at our own prices and hold it until a named person, or their rule, releases it.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id (ServiceM8, Simpro, or a job sheet)

emits.write: One draft invoice in Xero per completed job, keyed to the job id (reference job:<id>, and the stage under a building contract), every line a job line priced from the Xero Items read at draft time, carrying the book edition and any signed variation acceptance as evidence.
emits.readback: The invoice is read back from the ledger by the job id and must return the same invoice id, its Xero InvoiceID and the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed with the named owner and the run stops.

emits.write: The release on the invoice, naming the person who closed the awaiting-release exception or the rule (with its threshold) that person set, then the send from the ledger. Nothing parked is ever sent.
emits.readback: The invoice read back by its id shows status sent, the sent time, and released_by or released_by_rule, with the release recorded before the send.

emits.write: A parked or held invoice as an exception on the job: the reason (not_in_pricebook, unsigned_variation, no_stage, write_failed or awaiting_release), the job id, the invoice id, any codes left without a rate, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for invoices.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns the exception against the job id, and reading it back returns the job_id, invoice_id, reason and exception_owner; the next hop reads it there and stops.
